name: Solve algorithmic and competitive programming challenges
description: Users asked for code solutions to a wide variety of algorithmic and competitive programming contest problems, ranging from simple array manipulations and string processing to complex graph theory, dynamic programming, and data structure implementations. The requests frequently specified particular languages such as Python, C++, or Delphi, and often included constraints on time complexity, input formats, or specific algorithmic approaches like segment trees or backtracking.
